item.title: Enrique Maglione completes Uruguay Racing Team line-up
item.description: Uruguay Racing Team’s three-car line-up has been completed with the announcement of Enrique Maglione for the 2026 TCR South America season. item.title: Hyundai MSA announces Camilo Trappa for its second Hyundai
